subject: Onsite pilot at Redwood HQ — arrival logistics & credentials
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@pinnaclehealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tli@pinnaclehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot at Redwood HQ — initial visit window and security questions

Hi Aisha / Jordan,

Thanks for the quick call yesterday. We
t Pinnacle Health are excited to move the pilot to an on-site working session so our clinical ops and engineering teams can validate integrations and run a short usability exercise. Proposed window: Oct 20nd Oct 22; ideal for us would be Oct 21 for the hands-on portion.

High level asks from our side:
- Secure visitor badging (10 guests, list to follow)
- Mutual NDA before any clinical sample demo
- Confirmation on laptop policy (we may bring a locked clinical device)
- AV: HDMI + USB-C + single share laptop; will you provide a laptop for playback?
- Dietary restrictions for lunch (some folks are halal/vegetarian)

Icd Tom (engineering lead) and our security mailbox so we can handle the questionnaire. Can you confirm availability on Oct 21 and next steps for the NDA and badging?

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Partnerships | Pinnacle Health
[samira@pinnaclehealth.com]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@pinnaclehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tli@pinnaclehealth.com>, Pinnacle Health Security <pinnacle-security@pinnaclehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot at Redwood HQ — initial visit window and security questions

Hi Samira,

Great to hear — Oct 21 works on our end. We can host a 10-person on-site workshop in Conference Room G (capacity 12). Proposed schedule: 10:00
M arrival / 10:30
M welcome & overview / 11:00
M hands-on with engineers / 12:30
M lunch / 1:15
M wrap. If you prefer a different cadence, tell us.

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- I attached our standard mutual NDA (mutual_nda_v2.pdf) for review and DocuSign. Please sign before the demo.
- Please complete the visitor_badge_form.pdf for each attendee and return to me at least 72 hours before arrival (badging requires name + photo id).
- AV: We will provide a Dell TB16 docking with HDMI and USB-C adapters. If you require a specific clinical device to be connected, please note that in the visitor form so Site Security can pre-clear the device.
- Lunch: noted dietary needs; we can accommodate vegan/vegetarian/halal options.

If youcd Security, could your team send the questionnaire back to me and Icd Dev (events ops) to coordinate badges and catering?

Best,

Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: mutual_nda_v2.pdf, visitor_badge_form.pdf

From: Tom Li <tli@pinnaclehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot at Redwood HQ — initial visit window and security questions

Thanks Aisha.

Quick clarifications: we will confirm the guest list by EOD Friday. A couple of notes from ops/security:
- We prefer to bring our research laptop (company-owned) that contains de-identified samples; it cannot be uploaded to external systems. Is it acceptable to run locally and only present via screen-share?
- We may need a short network isolation (no internet upload) for the demo. Is there a private VLAN or offline room option?
- For AV: we
 like a microphone for Q&A if possible.

Aisha / Jordan,

I
 like to lock logistics now that Pinnacle confirmed Oct 21. Action items I
 like to confirm: 
- Room: Conference Room G reserved 09:30
M 515:00 on Oct 21 (capacity confirmed).
- Escort: Jordan to meet the group at the main lobby at 09:50 AM and escort to CR G.
- Badging: Icd Security (internal process started) - we need completed visitor_badge_form.pdf for each attendee by 10/18 EOD.
- Network: We can provision an isolated VLAN for the session; need Tom to confirm IP restrictions (no external uploads).
- AV: We will provide a tabletop mic and a presentation laptop. If Pinnacle wants to run their research laptop offline, Site Security will pre-clear the device on arrival and place it on an isolated VLAN.
- Catering: Ordered boxed lunch with vegetarian and halal options; see attached lunch_order.docx 
- Guest manifest: attached guest_list.csv (please review names/emails)
- Parking: We will issue a single day visitor permit (parking_permit_qr.png) per car; share car/plate if you need multiple permits.

Attachments: guest_list.csv, lunch_order.docx

Jordan, please confirm escort plan. Monica, fyi on final billing for catering and badges (Icd you).

Thanks,
Dev Patel
